title: Specimen Tray Series
description: Four reference-linked dim sum studies documenting handmade forms with museum-like calm.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the linen field, specimen spacing, and daylight archive mood. Images 02-04 preserve that exact atlas language while rotating among translucent dumplings, open crowns, and steamed buns.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-linen-specimen-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
